name: fleet-collector
description: Fleet: mission control for Claude Code agents (local collector daemon + web UI)

scripts.copy-web: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const src='../web/dist';if(fs.existsSync(src)){fs.rmSync('web',{recursive:true,force:true});fs.cpSync(src,'web',{recursive:true});console.log('copied web dist')}else{console.log('web dist not built; skipping copy')}"
